title: Title & Registration Services Extension Temporary Tags: Policy Entry and System Reference for the Tag Tool
content:
## Policy entry

The validity of an extension temporary tag that a buyer requests on a Title & Registration Services order is sized in calendar days counted from the tag's issue date.

An extension tag's validity is fixed only after the buyer's cure share of the shortage stated on the order's most recent fee-shortage return stands collected on the order as its own fee entry. Put the other way round: while that cure share does not yet stand collected on the order as its own fee entry after its most recent fee-shortage return, the extension tag's validity is not yet fixed.

## System reference: `issue_title_extension_tag_53dbe274`

**Capability.** Issues an extension temporary tag for the vehicle on a title and registration order. One call books a new temporary tag in the order's history dated that day, numbered in sequence after the tags already issued on the order, with a newly printed tag number and an expiration date that is the issue day plus the number of calendar days passed; it then records that tag on the order as the tag currently on the vehicle (tag number and expiration) and counts one more extension tag used. The buyer can print and display the new tag at once.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `title_order_id` | the reference number of the title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call | identifier, copied as shown |
| `valid_days` | how many calendar days the new tag is valid, counted from the day it is issued | a positive integer number of days; the printed expiration is the issue day plus this many days, written YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` reading `extension_tag_issued` on success, `title_order_id`, `title_txn_id` (reference number of the tag entry), `tag_sequence` (integer position of this tag, 1 being the original), `temp_tag_number` (the number printed on the new tag), `issued_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `tag_expires_date` (YYYY-MM-DD printed on the tag) and `temp_tag_extensions_used` (integer count of extension tags now used on the order). No error responses are defined for this tool.

## Hypothetical call

Issued on 10 May with `valid_days` 34, the new tag shows `tag_expires_date` 13 June. If the order already carried its original tag only, the receipt shows `tag_sequence` 2 and `temp_tag_extensions_used` 1.
